import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = plt.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values)
plt.yticks(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.index, fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, top_breeds.values)):
    plt.text(count + max(top_breeds.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by age group
plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].unique(), 
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = plt.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
plt.xticks(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('Dog Age Group', fontsize=11)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Dog Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog gender distribution
plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = plt.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
plt.setp(autotexts, size=11, weight='bold', color='white')
plt.setp(texts, size=11)
plt.title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog distribution by owner age group
plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
owner_age_order = sorted(df['AlterV10Lang'].unique(), 
                         key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = plt.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values)
plt.xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Dog Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Dog distribution by district (Kreis)
plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = plt.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
plt.xticks(range(len(district_counts)), [d.replace('Kreis ', '') for d in district_counts.index], 
           fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('District Number', fontsize=11)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Top 10 dog colors
plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
top_colors = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = plt.barh(range(len(top_colors)), top_colors.values)
plt.yticks(range(len(top_colors)), top_colors.index, fontsize=9)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Colors', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, top_colors.values)):
    plt.text(count + max(top_colors.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 7. Dog registrations over years
plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
plt.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=11)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 8. Mixed vs pure breed distribution
plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
df['BreedType'] = df['Rasse2Text'].apply(lambda x: 'Mixed Breed' if pd.notna(x) else 'Pure Breed')
breed_type_counts = df['BreedType'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FFA726', '#66BB6A']
wedges, texts, autotexts = plt.pie(breed_type_counts.values, labels=breed_type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
plt.setp(autotexts, size=11, weight='bold', color='white')
plt.setp(texts, size=11)
plt.title('Mixed vs Pure Breed Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dogs_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = plt.bar(dogs_per_owner.index, dogs_per_owner.values)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner', fontsize=11)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
plt.title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for bar, count in zip(bars, dogs_per_owner.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    plt.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(dogs_per_owner.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
